description: Predefined physician-review wording for aggression clozapine R6. The LLM never supplies this text; the app renders the matching branch deterministically from stored posteriors, evidence, and missingness. All slots are escaped at render time. No branch prescribes, doses, restarts, continues, stops, or clears clozapine, and no posterior is an aggression probability.

conditions.text: URGENT recorded finding: immediate danger to others or self, or another acute aggression-related concern requiring urgent assessment, is recorded. Seek immediate senior/emergency evaluation per local emergency protocol. Do not await model output; the clozapine discussion follows only after immediate safety is addressed.
URGENT recorded finding: a serious suspected treatment harm requiring urgent assessment is recorded. Seek immediate senior review per local safety protocol. Do not await model output.
conditions.when: clinician-recorded serious suspected harm present in the urgent assessment field

deterministic_urgent_flag.otherwise: No deterministic urgent flag fires. An Absent urgent assessment does not certify safety; the posterior branch above still requires physician review.
deterministic_urgent_flag.rule: Rendered directly from saved inputs WITHOUT waiting for any LLM request, inference result, or template posterior. Shown alongside (never replaced by) the posterior branch.

mapping_rule: Render the branch matching the highest-posterior AggressionRiskClozapineReviewPathway state ONLY as a review prompt; the posterior maximum is not a treatment recommendation and the physician may choose any course. Always show the indication, plan-review, and preparation posteriors alongside the pathway branch. Always evaluate deterministic_urgent_flag from saved inputs first. Always append unknown_disclosure. False gate renders not_applicable; unknown required gate renders needs_clarification.
unknown_disclosure: Inputs recorded as unavailable: {unknown_fields_or_none}. Unavailable is not a negative finding; clarify as clinically indicated. Optional gaps (adherence, modifiable targets, willingness, monitoring plan, medical review) leave their nodes without hard evidence; required gaps stop the question for clarification.
